description: Greenfield decision-tree source model for PersonaPlex multi-turn routing across persona/session assignment, Deepgram speech_final input, latest-turn-wins gating, memory intent/recall, clarify/deflect/evidence routes, bounded response release, and canonical memory persistence. This artifact is inspectable chart evidence only, not live implementation proof.

nodes.display_type: greenfield chart/doc sanity artifact; not live wrapper implementation proof

args: This DAG and HTML are local inspectable source-model artifacts only. They do not prove live PersonaPlex, Deepgram, memory, evidence-case, or gate behavior without separate real receipts.

nodes.display_type: assign persona_id, session_id, golden state, and stable persona context before audio

args: Create or load session_id and persona_id, load PersonaPlex golden state, preload stable persona context, and keep historical recommendations non-authoritative.

nodes.display_type: Deepgram speech_final turn produces transcript and optional audio artifact refs

args: Accept only finalized user-turn transcript when speech_final=true. If raw audio is retained, record artifact URI/hash metadata later; do not store audio blobs in Arango.

nodes.display_type: latest-turn-wins: assign turn_id, close output gate, cancel stale work, clear injections

args: Create active turn state with deterministic turn_id; close output gate; clear stale token queues; cancel or fence older memory/search/evidence tasks so stale results cannot inject or release output.

nodes.display_type: select compact session history from canonical memory before intent; wrapper owns token budget

args: Recall compact prior context from conversation_history_summaries plus bounded canonical conversation_history records. Historical query_plan/tool_calls/allowed_tools are audit context only and cannot authorize this turn.

nodes.display_type: /memory /intent for current turn returns action, confidence, recall_profile, query_plan, tool_calls, allowed_tools

args: Run /memory /intent for every current speech_final turn. The current intent result is the only authority for route, query_plan, tool_calls, allowed_tools, disallowed_tools, required_artifacts, recall_profile, and dependencies.

nodes.display_type: caller validates intent-recommended route/tools/dependencies and fails closed on invalid plan

args: Validate action, confidence, allowed_tools, disallowed_tools, depends_on, required_artifacts, and route invariants. Do not call any tool excluded by allowed_tools. Invalid or unsafe plans become clarify/deflect/fixed fallback, not free generation.

nodes.display_type: /memory /recall fetches route-required persona, compliance, source, or empty/no-op context after transcript+intent

args: For routes requiring grounding, fetch current-turn context after transcript and intent: persona_memory for persona facts, compliance/source collections for evidence routes, and declared profile/artifacts from intent.

nodes.display_type: DEFLECT/no-match route: /memory /deflect emits bounded packet only

args: If current intent action is DEFLECT or no-match, call /memory /deflect and emit a bounded deflection response packet. Bypass evidence-case and answer generation.

nodes.display_type: CLARIFY route: /memory /clarify asks one targeted follow-up and stops evidence work

args: If current intent action is CLARIFY or the request is ambiguous before evidence work, ask one targeted follow-up and emit a bounded clarify packet. Bypass evidence-case and answer generation.

nodes.display_type: compliance/security/control route: /create-evidence-case before answer generation

args: If current intent identifies compliance, security, control, audit, or evidence-case work, call /create-evidence-case before any answer generation. Evidence route must fail closed on missing or invalid source packets.

nodes.display_type: persona/current-fact blend route: allowed research plus /memory /answer bounded packet

args: For persona/current-fact blend questions, use only current intent-authorized research/tools plus recalled memory context, then produce a bounded /memory /answer packet. This path stays separate from compliance evidence-case routing.

nodes.display_type: recoverable evidence gap: ambiguous/underspecified/weak bridge routes to /memory /clarify

args: If evidence is inconclusive because entity, scope, control, source bridge, or user intent is ambiguous, route to /memory /clarify rather than generic fallback or free answer generation.

nodes.display_type: unclarifiable evidence/tool failure: fixed fallback, free generation blocked

args: If evidence/tool failure cannot be clarified safely, emit fixed fallback packet. Keep PersonaPlex factual generation blocked and preserve failure receipt details for canonical turn persistence.

nodes.display_type: coherent evidence: /memory /answer from evidence-case source packet only

args: If evidence-case output is coherent, answer only from the evidence source packet and recorded recall refs. Do not use unconstrained PersonaPlex generation for compliance claims.

nodes.display_type: route join: exactly one selected active-turn bounded packet may inject tokens

args: Join the selected route packet for the active turn only. Stale route packets, historical packets, and packets without active turn_id authority must be discarded and recorded as fenced/stale.

nodes.display_type: release output only after active packet readiness and safe queue drain

args: Open output gate only when active bounded packet is ready or fixed fallback is ready. The gate must not open with stale tokens or nonzero unsafe queue depth.

nodes.display_type: /memory /upsert canonical turn receipt to conversation_history with deterministic _key

args: Write canonical immutable turn receipt to conversation_history with _key=conversation:{session_id}:{turn_id}; include transcript, route action, selected tools, allowed/disallowed tools, recall/evidence refs, response packet hash, gate timings, safety outcome, retrieval_text, artifact refs, and hashes.

nodes.display_type: optional raw audio metadata: conversation_audio_artifacts stores URI/hash/retention/deletion/Qdrant pointers

args: If raw audio is retained, write conversation_audio_artifacts records with source_conversation_key, artifact_uri, sha256, codec, duration_ms, retention_class, deletion_state, and optional qdrant_audio_point_id plus deletion propagation status.

nodes.display_type: optional derived voice/debug projection only: personaplex_turns references source_conversation_key

args: If personaplex_turns exists, write it only as a derived voice/debug projection with source_conversation_key pointing to conversation_history. It must not be canonical and must not become a second authority.

nodes.display_type: budget threshold compaction: immutable conversation_history_summaries rolling summary

args: When wrapper-owned token budget threshold trips, write immutable rolling summary to conversation_history_summaries with _key=conversation_summary:{session_id}:{start_turn_id}:{end_turn_id}:{policy_version}; source canonical turn keys must be recorded.

nodes.display_type: update mutable personaplex_sessions head with generation/CAS semantics

args: Update personaplex_sessions _key=personaplex_session:{session_id} as mutable session head using generation/CAS semantics; store latest_turn_id, summary heads, active persona, policy versions, and deletion cursors.

nodes.display_type: next speech_final starts new active turn; stale tasks cannot open gate or authorize tools

args: A newer speech_final starts a new active turn, reruns current /memory /intent, cancels/fences stale work, and treats all historical tool recommendations as non-authoritative audit context.
